- Adds OOMOL connector support for FXMacroData macroeconomic and FX market data.
- Provides read actions for indicator catalogues, announcement history, latest releases, and release calendars.
- Supports CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning data for currency futures.
- Includes daily FX spot rate retrieval for currency pairs when an API key is available.
- Documents safe `oo` CLI usage, schema inspection, JSON payload execution, and first-time setup troubleshooting.
